accepted_response_contract: Nonempty JSON array with ActionDate and HistoryAction for the requested bill/session URL. Preserve literal fields and verify the requested identity; a portal loading shell is not a refreshed record.
method: Inspect the exact script resources linked by the official bill page; verify one endpoint response before batching further named histories. No login, subscription, CAPTCHA or browser interaction is used.
text_derivation: Lossless JSON pretty-print accepted separately; automatic extraction returns zero characters for JSON. Original body hashes and all values remain preserved.
scope: Reusable read-only source-recovery route, not automatic factual acceptance, equivalence, legislative-effect classification or proof of absent later actions.
